spec: Fix round 2 for T-1274: review T-1297 requested changes. fix round 2: address review T-1297 comment orchestrator/daemon.py:1666 [med]: When active mode is refused by the promotion gate, notify() fires on every tick for as long as the criteria stay unmet. test_active_promotion_refusal_uses_shadow asserts one notification per tick. That floods the notification channel. Also, promotion.collect re-reads the decision log on every tick in active mode. Notify only when the refusal reasons change, or once per interval. fix round 2: address review T-1297 comment orchestrator/decision_log.py:263 [med]: recent(kind, subject) scans backwards until it finds `limit` matching rows. A task normally has far fewer than 500 steering rows, so each call reads and json-parses the whole decisions.jsonl. _steering_decisions calls it once per running task per tick, which makes tick cost grow with total log size times the number of running tasks. Use a much smaller limit (only the last row and the applied rows  fix round 2: address review T-1297 comment orchestrator/promotion.py:122 [low]: Fix-round and token criteria for steering_policy are now skipped whenever active_n is 0. Active mode can therefore be promoted on shadow_n >= 20 alone. This is needed to bootstrap, but it means the fix-round criteria are only enforced after the first active row. The docs should say so. Separately, shadow_n now counts distinct root task ids instead of shadow rows, which is a stricter, unrequested c fix round 2: address review T-1297 comment orchestrator/steering_policy.py:38 [low]: read_scope() duplicates the spawn._packet_body derivation instead of reusing it, so the two can drift apart. It also joins task scope entries onto the worktree without a containment check. Extract a shared helper used by both, and skip scope entries that resolve outside the worktree. fix round 2 rule: Promotion refusal in active mode notifies only when the refusal reasons change (remember the last reasons on the pool object) and evaluates promotion at most once per min_interval_s, not every tick. decision_log.recent for steering reads the log once per tick and groups rows by subject (a per-tick cache handed to _steering_decisions), with a small limit, never one full-file scan per running task. Docs state that fix-round and token criteria for steering_policy apply only once active rows exist (bootstrap on shadow_n), and shadow_n counts rows again unless distinct roots was deliberate (keep rows, the spec asked for rows). Extract the read-scope derivation into one shared helper used by spawn._packet_body and steering_policy, skipping scope entries that resolve outside the worktree. Run .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh . until it exits 0; do not ask questions; report files changed and failures-only output.
acceptance: tests/test_steering_policy.py::test_triggers_in_order_and_actions (each trigger from fixtures yields the documented action and message)

Extract the read-scope derivation into one shared helper used by spawn._packet_body and steering_policy, skipping scope entries that resolve outside the worktree.
